SAVERIO'S AUTHENTIC PIZZA NAPOLETANA, Massapequa - Restaurant Reviews, Photos & Phone Number - Tripadvisor
s: I’m my opinion the pizza scene in Long Island is not breathtaking Saverios has received a lot of good reviews My wife and I went to check it out Attached to A&S pork store, it is a modest sized venue with outside seating as well For those who like beer, they have Peroni on tap which is very nice to have with a slice The wait staff was both watchful and courteous The meatball appetizer with ricotta was tasty The pizzas (not your typical too big LI pizzas) were a good size with a beautiful charred crust all around My only issue was due to the sauce and fresh mozzarella (the ingredients here are top notch) made the under crust to soft We both finished our pies save 2 slices each that we took home A little more well done on the bottom of the pie would have made these home runs And we will come back

s: May 6, 2025 - Saverio carries connotations of 'bright,' 'splendid,' or 'new house,' reflecting the etymological roots of the Basque place name from which it ultimately derives.
